readme: Food macro database for Thrifty Crew meal prep. Each item's calories/protein_g/carbs_g/fat_g are PER SERVING. serving_grams = grams in one serving (used to scale by weight, e.g. pounds). For count or volume items (eggs, tbsp), serving_qty + serving_unit describe the serving. Conversions: 1 lb = 453.592 g, 1 oz = 28.3495 g. Note raw vs cooked for meats. brand empty string = not specified yet. null macro = pending label.
